# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-to-late fifties  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c4 P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with sharp angles and dark hair showing gray streaks, which she twists into a hard knot secured by aggressive wire hairpins. She possesses a mouth that hints at an underdeveloped sense of humor. Over the years, her hair whitens to a snow-white shade, though her dark eyes and general appearance remain otherwise remarkably constant despite her advancing years.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v3 c36 P26](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0026), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and strict morality, who takes a serious, practical view of life. Though crisp, curt, and often sarcastic on the surface, she possesses a hidden warmth, deep capacity for affection, and an understated humor. Firm and resolute once her mind is made up, she holds strong moral standards and is deeply devoted to her duty. Over time, her upbringing of children mellows her disposition, softening her severity with patience and understanding.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v3 c30 P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002)_

## Goals

- To raise Anne Shirley and later the Keith twins into proper, useful citizens  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)</sub>
- To maintain and preserve Green Gables as a family home  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert and her brother Matthew intended to adopt an orphan boy to help on their farm, but through a misunderstanding, Anne Shirley was sent to them instead. Though Marilla initially insisted on sending Anne back, she agreed to keep her upon seeing the child's plight and yielded to Matthew's quiet wishes. She took full charge of Anne's upbringing, attempting to curb her wild imagination, talkativeness, and temper with strict discipline, though she quickly grew deeply attached to her. Following Matthew's sudden death, Marilla faced the prospect of selling Green Gables due to failing eyesight, but Anne gave up her college scholarship to stay home and help her. Soon after, Marilla invited the widowed Mrs. Rachel Lynde to live at Green Gables, enabling Anne to attend Redmond College while the twins, Davy and Dora Keith, were brought to live at the homestead. Over the years, Marilla supported Anne through her college career, her engagement, and her marriage to Gilbert Blythe, eventually welcoming her grandchildren and continuing her life at Green Gables into advanced old age.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v3 c34 P10](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0010), [v4 c2 P8](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0008), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea at the Green Gables homestead founded by her father  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007)</sub>
- Had a youthful romance and quarrel with John Blythe, whom she refused to forgive  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Lived for years at Green Gables with her shy brother Matthew  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007)</sub>
